Name: FadeHeim's anime Rosa (East Scarp) - alt Spirits Eve portrait
Author: bezajel
AuthorLabel: bezajel based on FadeHeim and Poltergeister
Description:
FadeHeim has made an excellent set of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37247]seasonal anime portraits for East Scarp[/url]﻿, in which she interpreted Rosa's Spirits Eve outfit as a Día de Muertos costume.

It's a great outfit, but for me it didn't match the sprite well enough. So I made a version that used Poltergeister's original Seasonal Cute design of a mime outfit. FadeHeim kindly gave me permission to share my version.

The download consists of ONE (1) image file ONLY, to replace the file in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37247]FadeHeim's mod[/url].

*******

[u]Credits:
[/u]
Edits by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/bezajel]bezajel[/url] based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/FadeHeim]FadeHeim[/url]'s Rosa portrait and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url]﻿'s Seasonal Cute outfit.

The character Rosa was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat]Lemurkat[/url]﻿, and her original portrait by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz]Rafseazz[/url].
